recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied rename without changing the multi-resource filter semantics preserved by FHIR-39033; only normal build regeneration may further rewrite the checked-in SVG.
issue_request: FHIR-41197 was Applied/Persuasive for R5 and requested renaming Subscription.filterBy.resourceType to resource because the resourceType element name caused issues with JSON serializers/parsers and had been missed when matching SubscriptionTopic elements were renamed.
initial_application: The original FHIR-41197 application commit dc74cb37a2095621b5fd69bd1eb0217f7d381c18 renamed the authoritative Subscription StructureDefinition element and two examples. Current source still contained resourceType in Subscription narrative guidance, framework guidance, a negative invariant test instance, and the checked-in Subscription UML SVG.
additional_context: FHIR-28490 introduced the Subscription filter resource discriminator for multi-resource subscriptions. FHIR-39033 later confirmed that the discriminator should remain because filters can apply only to some triggering resources. FHIR-46492 later refactored SubscriptionTopic paths under trigger, which explains current references to SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.resource while preserving the Subscription.filterBy.resource semantics.
reconciliation: Changed source/subscription/subscription-notes.xml and source/subscriptions.html to name Subscription.filterBy.resource, changed source/subscription/invariant-tests/scr-1.f1.fail.xml to use the valid renamed child while still failing scr-1 for comparator-plus-modifier, and aligned source/subscription/subscription.svg to the renamed element link and label.
source_changes: source/subscription/subscription-notes.xml: replaced the stale Subscription.filterBy.resourceType code reference with Subscription.filterBy.resource.
source/subscriptions.html: updated the Filters and Resource Types guidance to refer to Subscription.filterBy.resource when the filter resource is omitted or broad.
source/subscription/invariant-tests/scr-1.f1.fail.xml: changed the filterBy child from resourceType to resource so the negative fixture remains valid except for the intended scr-1 violation.
source/subscription/subscription.svg: updated the checked-in UML label and link from Subscription.filterBy.resourceType/resourceType to Subscription.filterBy.resource/resource.
